name: Get Actor Location
description: Returns the actor's current world-space location as a Vector, reading from its root component. Often paired with Break Vector to inspect or operate on individual axes.

inputs.name: Target
inputs.description: The actor whose location to read. Connect a Get reference, a Spawn Actor output, or a self-reference (often hidden).

outputs.name: Return Value
outputs.description: The actor's world-space position from its root component. Connect to math nodes, Set Actor Location, or Break Vector.
